data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 神座下的奉献夜·「神、神殿里……不可以太用力……」
data.description: 【神殿圣座·深夜】女神在圣座上仰起头，婚纱般的薄纱散落在台阶上。动情的欢愉让她的十指扣紧了王座扶手，金环耳饰在散发间摇晃，红瞳里泛起诸神都不曾见过的泪光——「哈啊……这里、这里可是本女神的圣座……要、要对圣座温柔一点……凡、凡人的大胆……也太越权了……」
data.action: 仰卧神殿圣座台阶双腿轻微分开自抚，金纱散落金环摇晃，红瞳含泪恍惚喘息
data.lighting: 圣座烛台的暖光与金饰反光
data.camera: vertical POV, supine, touching own body, sacred throne steps, candlelight and golden reflections
data.promptProse: On the temple's sacred marble throne steps with translucent bridal-thin veils scattered around her, Ishtar arches her slender back in an overwhelming rush of divine ecstasy. Her fingers clutch the carved armrests while her golden hoop earrings catch the warm candlelight, ruby red eyes glistening with rare, vulnerable tears no mortal has ever witnessed. Her small divine chest rises and falls rapidly as one trembling hand touches her inner thigh, protesting between ragged gasps that mortal audacity on the goddess's throne has exceeded all bounds. Intimate vertical composition, cinematic lighting, golden glow, detailed temple background.
